title: Great app but no trial and no negative habits
body: Just as title said, I'm surprised there's no trial before making a commitment and no negative habits. I'd say the stats screen (from what I'm able to see in free version) is also a bit too simple focusing mainly on these boxes (which is probably a design choice). Otherwise looks like a solid app with nice design (I do like the "today" screen).
author: Kristjan789
